# SolarOps

*An end-to-end operating platform for rooftop solar installation businesses.*

SolarOps connects customer enquiries, sales, field teams and warehouse operations in one installation lifecycle. It carries survey evidence and versioned quotations through order fulfilment, serialised equipment, installation acknowledgment, warranty and after-sales service—so each team works from persisted business records.

# Praxis

**Artifact-first AI evaluation with executable contracts, persisted evidence and condition-matched comparisons.**

Praxis is a local evaluation workspace and Python runner for inspecting what models, tool agents and HTTP applications actually produce. Versioned scenarios define inputs, output schemas and assertions; the runner records outputs, failures, tool traces, timing and provenance before assembling a report. A React interface supports target registration, suite authoring, run review, artifact inspection and blind preference comparisons, while a separate Cloudflare Worker exposes a limited authenticated metadata API.

WorldSpeak turns explicitly chosen communication intent into deterministic English/Tamil sentences. Review exact words, then deliberately press Speak; Stop remains available. Object selection, model output, replay and language changes never authorize speech. A prepared essential board works offline without sign-in.

[Engineering documentation](docs/README.md)

## Communication architecture

WorldSpeak separates selecting meaning, rendering words and authorizing speech. A typed composition holds an intent, locale, catalog version and revision. The immutable reducer increments that revision when meaning or language changes. Deterministic templates render structured requests, polarity and object slots; exact user-entered text is preserved rather than rewritten or translated. Unknown objects and missing slots fail explicitly.

# RLB — Relax Lemme Build

**An AI engineering runtime with durable tasks, human approval gates and recoverable publication.**

RLB coordinates planning, code proposals, test execution, repair and review against a project on the user's machine. A Python worker persists workflow state in SQLite; a Next.js interface exposes tasks and evidence, while an Electron desktop shell packages the local services. An optional hosted control plane carries authenticated commands, review decisions and events to the paired runtime.

The central engineering problem is keeping execution, human decisions and file publication consistent across retries, cancellation, process interruption and disconnected remote control. Model responses are inputs to a persisted workflow; they do not bypass the plan or code approval gates.

# StockSense

**Transactional inventory management with a movement ledger and concurrency-safe stock updates.**

StockSense is a Next.js application backed by PostgreSQL and Prisma for one shared inventory workspace. Receipts, deliveries, internal transfers and physical counts update current quantities and historical movements through the same transaction engine. Catalog management, warehouse locations, authentication and browser workflows surround that engine.

[Inventory engine](src/server/inventory/) · [Database model](prisma/schema.prisma) · [Integration verification](scripts/verify-integration.ts) · [Review evidence](docs/REVIEW.md)

## Inventory model

`StockQuant` holds the current quantity for a unique product/location pair; `Product` does not carry an authoritative on-hand total. `StockMove` records completed movement history, linked to its originating operation. Both use PostgreSQL `Decimal(18,4)` through Prisma Decimal arithmetic, avoiding binary floating-point arithmetic for stock quantities.

# Survey Data Intelligence

**SIRL · Explainable survey-quality analysis with rules, statistics and Isolation Forest.**

Survey Data Intelligence turns CSV or eSIGMA-format submissions into a persisted data-quality investigation workflow. A Python pipeline normalizes records, stores Parquet batches, builds structured profiles, combines three validation channels, and exposes record-level evidence through a Next.js dashboard. Optional AI explains selected evidence after scoring; it does not assign risk or decide whether a record violates a validity rule.

The bundled PLFS-oriented examples and ground-truth evaluation are **synthetic/demo data**. The implementation is designed for inspecting survey quality and unusual response patterns; an anomaly signal is a reason to investigate, not proof of fabrication.

# Enterprise RAG Platform

**Authenticated, tenant-isolated retrieval with grounded answers, persistent usage governance, and deployable infrastructure.**

A modular Python service for enterprise knowledge retrieval. Documents are chunked, embedded, stored in Qdrant, filtered by tenant and access level, optionally reranked, and returned as cited evidence. PostgreSQL records usage and reserves tenant budgets before a hosted generation call; Redis coordinates rate limits across API replicas.

The platform can keep documents and inference on your infrastructure. The default development configuration uses deterministic lexical embeddings and extractive answers so the complete request path runs without downloading models or sending documents to a provider. Production mode requires semantic embeddings and PostgreSQL. Hosted generation is separately enabled and explicitly permits authorized context to leave your environment.

# THE ATRIUM

A procedural 3D multiplayer mystery for 2–4 people. Hide a key in your Clockwork Library, read rivals’ clues, search their universes, and unlock the central portal.

## Authoritative multiplayer architecture

The browser uses Three.js to render a procedural library and Colyseus to exchange player intent with a Node.js server. The [game engine](apps/server/src/game.ts) owns phase transitions, clues, key ownership, round assignments and the winner. Keeping that logic separate from transport makes game rules testable without a browser or WebGL context.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Player[Player controls] --> Client[Three.js client]
    Client -->|Validated intent messages| Server[Colyseus room and admission]
    Server --> Game[Authoritative game state]
    Game --> View[Per-player presentation]
    View -->|Personalized JSON snapshots at 20 Hz| Client
    Game --> Deadline[Server phase deadlines and tie-breaking]
```

Clients receive personalized views rather than every player's hidden answer. Preparation, one visit per rival and the finale advance against server deadlines; collecting a key twice does not duplicate inventory. Disconnected seats retain their rooms and searchable secrets during the match, and host authority transfers. The rendering client interpolates presentation; it does not decide whether a key was earned or a portal unlocked.

# Space Debris Simulation — Modular Thruster Framework

Educational research simulation of a modular rocket that deploys three solar-powered thrusters
for orbital debris collection. Provides GUI telemetry, mission logging, debris collection modeling,
and simple data export for research.

## Features
- Login & registration (in-memory for demo)
- Mission config window (orbit altitude, launch site, etc.)
- Main GUI telemetry: temperature, thruster speed, mission log (real-time)
- Simulation phases: prelaunch → ascent → collection → return
- Debris stochastic model with per-thruster collections
- CSV export of telemetry and debris logs
- Simplified orbital helper functions (placeholders for more accurate physics)
- Tests for core modules

# Hazard Zone Sentinel

**From warehouse perception to actionable safety events.**

Hazard Zone Sentinel transforms warehouse video into actionable safety intelligence. It detects and tracks workers, evaluates restricted-zone activity and delivers structured incidents to an operations dashboard for review, acknowledgment and analysis.

Built for **Track A — PipeGen (Perception)** of the **Embedded SF: CraftifAI Physical AI Hackathon**, the project brings together a complete PipeGen pipeline, a compiled TensorRT engine, an NVIDIA DeepStream execution and downstream safety operations. It also includes an independent AI Camera Monitor for browser-connected cameras and new video sources.

# Akilan P L — Portfolio

A responsive portfolio with a WebGL opening, a scroll-driven project gallery, project details, professional experience, and a downloadable resume.

## How the site works

The page combines a fixed Three.js WebGL scene with ordinary HTML sections. Scroll position drives the opening scene and project gallery; project controls and detail dialogs expose the same project records. Experience, contact links and the resume remain in the document layer. A WebGL fallback supplies a static background, and reduced-motion preferences adjust motion behavior.

Three.js and its environment helper are vendored under `dist/assets/`; there is no application backend or database. Serving over HTTP allows the browser's JavaScript modules and assets to resolve correctly. The project summaries link to their engineering repositories, where current implementation and verification evidence can be inspected.
